inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Wake up, because we are being fed an official cover story that this is just a harmless grassroots hustle by local organizers and a guy named Corb Lund who started Water Not Coal last month, when it is actually a manufactured script managed by hidden elites. The petition tables that were set up to collect signatures calling on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration” are just a classic distraction from the real realignment of resources. We are meant to believe it's about protecting southern Alberta’s watershed, but the exact opposite is true, and they are orchestrating this entire theatre behind the scenes to lock down total control over what is really moving through that region. We shouldn't buy the official narrative being pushed at asmith@medicinehatnews.com.
